label: The Edgerunners Gambit

teams.notes: EDGERUNNERS DEBUT. Lucy S1 + Rebecca S0 opener. Nearly doubled Changli softener floor (4,037 → 7,029 = +74%). Matrix Swarm R1 killed, Fleurdelys R1 to 24.8%. The gambit's first domino.

Pivoted ahead of Zani — Sigillum Spectro resistance walled Spectro Beta. Augusta's Heavy ATK carved through. Fleurdelys R1 cleaned, Sigillum R1 killed, Reactor Husk R1 to 44.48%. Personal best Endstate score (prev: 6,677).
Reset after Sigillum wall. Redeployed post-Augusta with resistance cleared. Reactor Husk R1 cleaned, Matrix Mimic R1 to 19.41%. Personal best (prev: 5,507). Potato growth arc: 5,363 → 5,507 → 5,692.

SK oopsie — both vigor burned on Augusta + Zani. Mornye subbed in. Tune Strain synergy with Hack/Tune Break buff nearly compensated (8,008 → 7,473 = -535pts / -6.7%). Matrix Mimic R1 cleaned, pushed into R2 Matrix Swarm to 4.3%.
R2 scaling hit — down from 7,876 in C2. Inherited scaled bosses from Carlotta's R2 push. Matrix Swarm R2 cleaned, Fleurdelys R2 to 23.32%. Cantarella's CR fix still printing, three months running.

Zero sustain comp Endstate debut. Pivoted ahead of Cartethyia — Fleurdelys is Aero resistant, Aemeath doesn't care. Fleurdelys R2 cleaned, Sigillum R2 killed, Reactor Husk R2 to 65.19%. Down from 14,844/12,553 but those had Mornye sustain. Pure violence, no apologies.
CHISA CAME HOME. The entire Edgerunners Gambit existed to free Chisa for this team. Reactor Husk R2 cleaned, Matrix Mimic R2 to 32.97%. Three cycles, three crowns/SSS — the sweet potato doesn't miss.
THE MAGISTRATE DELIVERS. 3/3 cycles. 3,421 → 3,646 → 3,994 — improved every cycle. Matrix Mimic R2 cleaned, pushed into R3 Matrix Swarm (95.01%). The closer arc is mythology now.

lessons: Edgerunners > Changli softener — Lucy/Rebecca/Mornye at 7,029 nearly doubled the old 4,037 floor. Changli is benched. New opener established.
Resistance pivot is non-negotiable — Sigillum walled Zani (Spectro), Fleurdelys walled Cartethyia (Aero). Mid-run reordering saved thousands of points both times.
SK vigor planning FIRST — burning both SK vigor on Augusta + Zani left Carlotta without CR stability. Cost ~535 points. Plan healer vigor allocation before deployment.
Mornye + Tune Break buff is a legitimate sub for SK — the Tune Strain synergy with Hack/Tune Break Enhancement nearly compensated for lost CR floor. Keep this in the toolbox.
Triple Pink Danger is Endstate-viable — 10,776 SSS with zero sustain. The no-healer gamble works when Aemeath's kill speed outpaces the damage intake. R2 scaling is the limit.
Zani reset trick — if a team hits a resistance wall, reset and redeploy after another team clears the wall. The reshuffle lesson from C2 now has a specific tactic: wall-clear-then-redeploy.
Jinhsi closer arc: 3/3 — it's mythology — she improves every cycle and has never missed the number. Don't overthink the closer slot. Trust the Magistrate.
Chisa allocation is the keystone — the entire Edgerunners Gambit was a Chisa-freeing operation. Wherever Chisa goes, plan the rest of the roster around her. She's the domino that moves everything.
